sources.title: GitHub - izm1chael/layerfault: Offline-first local AI model admission ...
sources.snippet: Layerfault Offline-first static admission and sandboxed behavioural security for local AI models. Layerfault validates model artifacts, packages and local runtimes before inference, then can optionally exercise supported models inside a locked-down Linux sandbox to look for runtime side effects and suspicious behavioural divergence.

sources.title: Loading models · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Memory usage for models requiring dynamic weight conversion depends on the model size and the size of the largest parameters in a single conversion. This typically applies to mixture-of-experts (MoE) models where the memory usage is the model size plus the number of experts on one layer.
